title: OptionCandidate
description: candidates.option_candidate r1: one evaluated option candidate of one run, with its gates; insert only, a rerun is a new run_id.

session_day.description: Run day: the session day the rows were computed for.

run_id.description: Run id of the runner; a rerun is a new run_id and rows are insert-only.

alias.description: Account alias of the row; empty for puts.

rule_version.description: Version of the rule that computed the row.

issuer.description: Issuer text of the watch list entry of the underlying.

dte.description: Calendar days from the chain day to the expiry.

bid_eod.description: End-of-day bid at the freeze as decimal text; an estimate of the premium, not a fill.

ask.description: End-of-day ask as decimal text; null when absent.

spot.description: Price of the underlying at the capture as decimal text; null when absent.

buy_price.description: Owner buy price per share as decimal text; null when unset.

sale_price.description: Owner sale price per share as decimal text; null when unset.

break_even.description: Break-even per share as decimal text: strike minus bid for a put, strike plus bid for a call.

annualized_yield.description: Annualized yield as decimal text to 6 places; null when not computed.

delta.description: Delta as decimal text; null when absent.

iv.description: Implied volatility as decimal text (0.25 is 25 percent); null when absent.

status.description: Row status: blocked if any gate blocked, else unknown if any gate is unknown, else ok.

gates.description: Ordered JSON array text of the gate results, each {gate, status, reason}.

marks.description: JSON array text of the marks of the row, for example itm; empty array text when none.

fits.description: JSON object text from alias to fit, no_fit or unknown; empty object text when no alias applies.

next_earnings.description: Next results date from the earnings reader; null when none.

earnings_state.description: State of the earnings row: listed, absent, unsupported, error or none.

next_ex_date.description: Next ex-dividend date; null when none.

ex_amount.description: Dividend amount per share of the next ex-date as decimal text; null when none.

extrinsic.description: Extrinsic value per share as decimal text; null when not computed.

rank.description: Position of an ok row in the run; null when not ranked.

rank_in_underlying.description: Position of an ok row within its underlying; null when not ranked.

computed_at.description: Instant the run computed the row, UTC; the newest run of a day is the one with the latest computed_at.
